	end
	e:GetOwner():SetTurnCounter(0)

		local e1,e2,e3=table.unpack(s[0][e])
		e:Reset()
		if e1 then e1:Reset() end
		if e2 then e2:Reset() end
		if e3 then e3:Reset() end
		s[0][e]=nil
		for i,te in ipairs(s[0]) do
			if te==e then
				table.remove(s[0],i)
				break
			end
		end
	end

		Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,1-tp,aux.Stringid(id,1))
		if #cg>0 then
			sel=Duel.SelectOption(1-tp,1213,1214)
		else
			sel=Duel.SelectOption(1-tp,1214)+1
		end
		if sel==0 then
			Duel.Hint(HINT_SELECTMSG,1-tp,HINTMSG_CONFIRM)
			local sg=cg:Select(1-tp,1,1,nil)
			Duel.ConfirmCards(tp,sg)
			Duel.ShuffleHand(1-tp)
			Duel.NegateEffect(0)
			return
		end
	end
	local g=Duel.GetTargetCards(e)
	Duel.Destroy(g,REASON_EFFECT)
end
